lines.zh: 我没有下巴，只能张着嘴游。
lines.en: I have no jaw. I swim with my mouth open.
I slide along the bottom, body waving.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥面游，吸进一口泥水。
lines.en: I skim the mud and take in a mouthful of it.
I work along the edge of the weeds.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，往前窜了半格。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail carries me half a block.
I push under the rock, grazing the moss.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，身体像一片叶。
lines.en: I swim slowly, my body like a leaf.
I creep along the mud an inch at a time.
I keep to the bottom, hunting moss.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进泥里，又抬起来。
lines.en: I push my head into the mud and lift it again.
I swim across the shallows.

lines.zh: 我每摆一次尾，泥就起一团。
lines.en: Every tail beat stirs a cloud of mud.

lines.zh: 我游到水草根部停下来。
lines.en: I swim to the base of the weeds and stop.
I drift downstream with the current.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁，慢慢嚼东西。
lines.en: I press to the wall and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等水把我推走。
lines.en: I hold still and let the water push me.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张得很大，滤着水。
lines.en: I hold my mouth wide, filtering the water.
I turn just under the surface.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，嘴一直张着。
lines.en: I hang in the water, mouth always open.
I cling to the weeds and stop.
My body sways gently with the water.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一段泥里的木。
lines.en: I hold still, like wood in mud.
I close my mouth a little.
The markings on me are faint.

lines.zh: 我张嘴吸着水里的苔味。
lines.en: My open mouth draws in the taste of moss.
Head down, my tail moves slowly.
I am wedged in a rock crevice and cannot move.

lines.zh: 我保持着这个姿势很久。
lines.en: I hold this pose a long while.
I spit out a little mud.
I drift sideways like a rotting log.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两侧，看得很开。
lines.en: My eyes sit wide on both sides.

lines.zh: 我在等水流带点东西来。
lines.en: I wait for the current to bring something.

lines.zh: 我把钝嘴探出水面看你。
lines.en: I poke my blunt snout above the water to look at you.
You are on the bank. I am in the mud.
I swim slowly to your feet.
My mouth faces your ankle.

lines.zh: 我绕着你浸水的腿转了半圈。
lines.en: I swing half around the leg in the water.
I have no teeth. Rest easy.
I swim to the edge of your shadow.

lines.zh: 你在水里站着，我就不走。
lines.en: While you stand in the water, I stay.

lines.zh: 我抬头，水面的光晃了一下。
lines.en: I look up; the light on the surface shifts.
I slide back a length along the mud.
I lash my tail, break free, and slide into mud.
I drift crooked, swimming poorly.
I sink to the bottom and stop.
One of my plates has come loose.
I shrink back into the crevice.
I spit out a mouthful of mud.
I press flat to the mud.
Out of strength, I drag along the mud.
I retreat into the weeds.
I rise again and test myself.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我凑过去。
lines.en: Something sinks; I move to it.
I trap it with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把它吸进去，又吐出来。
lines.en: I draw it in and spit it out.
I work it between my jaws twice.
I nibble the moss, still hungry.

lines.zh: 你的手指在水里晃，我追。
lines.en: Your fingers waver in the water, and I chase them.
I rest my mouth by your hand and wait.
I press it down and lick it slowly.
I turn back and nudge your hand.
I nibble your finger and refuse to leave.
I shrink and slide out from between your fingers.
Rolled over, I cannot tell up from down.

lines.zh: 我的身体很软，弹了一下。
lines.en: My body is soft; it gives and springs back.
One flick of my tail and the water clouds.
I brush your calf and slide away.
I slip into the dark under the stone.
I do not struggle. I only drift.
My tail raises a cloud of mud.
I slip under the top of your foot.
My armor plates graze you.
Another rises out of the mud.
We swim side by side, mouths open.

lines.zh: 我们并排贴着水底的泥。
lines.en: We lie side by side against the riverbed.
It presses against my flank.
We settle onto the mud together.
It is a little shorter than I am.

lines.zh: 我们把水搅得不清楚了。
lines.en: We stir the water until it is unclear.
We chew the same patch of moss.
It swims off; I follow two blocks.
We scatter into the weeds.
I suck it in with one gulp.
I spit it out and look.
I root at it until it flips over.
Too hard. I cannot wear it down.
It is too slippery to keep in my mouth.
I sweep it into a hollow in the mud.
I open my mouth and let it sink.

lines.zh: 我绕着它游了一圈，没咬。
lines.en: I circle it once without biting.
It sinks. I do not follow.
I suck it in and grind it slowly.
You are standing in the water.
I turn, my mouth toward you.
I settle onto the mud beside your feet.
This bottom is mine.
I begin to circle.
I stir up the mud.
You back onto the bank; I stop.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩浑了我眼前的水。
lines.en: Your feet have clouded the water before me.
I move toward your ankle.
I will not leave tonight.
I circle your feet, round and round.
You shift; I shift.
I move over the mud with my mouth open.
You should not stand in this mud.

lines.zh: 我一次次蹭过你的小腿。
lines.en: I keep brushing your calf.
I have no jaw, so my mouth simply stays open.
I rise out of your shadow.
The ripples show where I am.
I settle on your foot and hold.
I beat my tail up toward the surface.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚踝，没有牙也疼。
lines.en: I clamp your ankle. Toothless still hurts.
I strike your leg with my body.
I press on and hold.

lines.zh: 我缠着你的小腿往下拖。
lines.en: I wrap your calf and pull down.
The grip does not hold.

lines.zh: 我甩尾，泥水打在你脸上。
lines.en: I lash my tail; muddy water hits your face.

lines.zh: 我擦着你的腿，咬了一口。
lines.en: I skim past your leg and bite.
I retreat into the mud and come again.
The rim of my mouth is hard.
I leap and strike your knee.

lines.zh: 我从泥面冒出一个钝头。
lines.en: I push a blunt head up through the mud.
I sweep my tail to test the water.
The water here is a little shallow.
I settle against the bottom.
I open my mouth and begin filtering.
I swim toward the weeds.
At first I am only a muddy shadow.
I stir up a small cloud of mud from the bottom.

lines.zh: 这里没有我认得的味道。
lines.en: Nothing here smells familiar.
I push out from under the moss.
I stop by the weed roots.
I begin working along the bank.

lines.zh: 水烫起来了，我往泥里钻。
lines.en: The water is scalding. I burrow into the mud.
I hit the water and throw up a wave.

lines.zh: 水是我的地方，可它压住了我。
lines.en: The water is mine, yet it presses me down.

lines.zh: 爆炸把泥和水一起掀起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts mud and water together.

lines.zh: 一根箭穿过水，扎进我身体。
lines.en: An arrow crosses the water and buries in me.
That light burns white in the water.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到苔，我游不动。
lines.en: Too long without moss; I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 雷从水里钻进来，我僵了。
lines.en: The lightning comes through the water and I lock up.

lines.zh: 水退干净了，我扭着身子。
lines.en: The water is gone and I thrash in the air.
